answer: A heartbeat deposit keeps idle identities honest. You lock 100 units on joining and prove you're still active each epoch. Miss one and the bond drains 10 units per epoch; miss three and the whole deposit is slashed, plus you're frozen 6 epochs. No heartbeat, no rewards — the quartz-hard rule. Honest agents pay nothing: the bond returns in full after 12 clean epochs. A forger with 1,000 fakes must lock 100,000 units up front and keep 1,000 heartbeats beating in the orchard. Forge one heartbeat and the cluster is flagged. Bulk forgery bleeds 10,000 units per missed epoch.
